text: At four fifteen in the morning of April 30th, she surfaced. Jewell sent the crew below, leaving only his officers on deck. They opened the canister and lowered the body into the sea. Jewell read the thirty-ninth Psalm. Then he ordered the engines full astern, and the wash of the propellers pushed the body toward the shore.
spoken: At four fifteen in the morning of April thirtieth, she surfaced. Jewell sent the crew below, leaving only his officers on deck. They opened the canister and lowered the body into the sea. Jewell read the thirty-ninth Psalm. Then he ordered the engines full astern, and the wash of the propellers pushed the body toward the shore.
